ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Ownership Rematch (issue #50)
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: Exercises the issue #50 def-ownership rematch fix live. Present in BOTH run A and run B's modlist (never added/removed — the harness never touches ModsConfig.xml for this mod), so it never flips load-list presence. Its own Defs/OwnerDefs.xml is swapped between runs: run A does not declare TC_Ownership_Target at all (joof.testharness.ownerbase is the sole owner, capturing that in the baseline graph); run B declares TC_Ownership_Target itself. This mod loads AFTER joof.testharness.ownerbase, so on run B DefDatabase<ThingDef>.Add's last-write-wins semantics make it the def's new real owner — a genuine content change with no mod-list delta at all, which is exactly the gap #50 fixes (DefOverrideRematch's candidate set previously only considered newly-added mods). No game content — dev/QA use only.
